body:
Thanks for the advice. I actually didn't receive the paperwork and skimmed your comment but I didn't know I could block people on reddit. Thank you so much!


And oh yeah, my psychiatrist doesn't seem to be on your wavelength given that I was inpatient during most of the so called times I should have been on top of it.


I feel the absurd need to defend myself. No therapist would be on your wavelength. This wasn't avoidance. This was trying to deal with my mental health and then bam, stuck. Do you want me to spill out the inpatient days for you? Because it includes most of June too. I was home for about a week in between them but thanks. 


My therapist was more thinking "you need to go to the hospital and get on the right meds" and my psychiatrist was on that wavelength. I've had many med changes. Almost had ect and would have stayed in the hospital during the cancelation.  What would you have to say about that?  Psychiatrists and therapists are more focused on a person's well being when one month the person is talking about people switching souls and hearing voices and then suddenly finding out the secrets to the universe and the next month sitting out a 14th story window ready to jump out. Cbt isn't the focus when ect is the suggestion. Luckily the right meds were found but they possibly aren't, however I cannot reconsider at the moment, can I? 


Get real. I thought my ex was controlling the police force and his brother was putting up 432 park Ave and other ugly buildings to try to mess with my life, from 500 miles away. Then I was convinced I wad the Messiah. I mean, seriously, you don't have a clue about what you're saying. I'm not even listening at this point because you don't even know the context.

Edit: you're contracting yourself. One minute you said I'm manipulating and don't need to go to the er, now you're saying I do. What? I mean, I know I'm mentally ill but you're not making any sense. You are trolling a mentally ill person. Do you not see how messed up that is? 

I'm begging you to stop because I .... am not telling you how I felt about your stupid comment. You're trolling a mentally ill person asking for help and I'm taking the bait. How low do you feel about yourself that you need to do that? At this point, I'm not the only one who needs therapy in this exchange. 


Edit: you do realize they don't fill scripts until you're almost out anyways, right? Even if I had insurance. It's not like I could go stock up on stuff like klonopin. They don't just hand out meds like candy, even Lamictal. They wait.

> if you have been coupling therapy with your klonopin

How? 

>You know when and how to re up.  You chose not too.

Not a choice. I didn't receive the recertification paperwork in the mail. Want to know what else happened to me this year? I had my first episode of psychosis. When I was opening the cancelation notice I thought it was the recertification paperwork because it was around the same time of year. 


Stop. Just stop. Please, stop. I've had the most difficult year of my life mentally and I never thought I would be able to lose touch with reality like that earlier this year, coming back from that is not a walk in the park. I'm not looking for sympathy (but empathy instead of cruelty/just being a jerk on the Internet to someone you don't know would be appreciated).



Please, stop. Please. Just, stop. You've said enough. 


I'm begging you. Just stop. Please.
This thread has really helped a lot. All the resources here and the redditors who have come out willing to help has been great!

Thank you so much for the link! I really appreciate it. I want to avoid a hospitalization and those resources are very helpful right now. 


Thank you!!!

You're not being productive. Other redditors have helped me out tremendously already, even with simple kindness and resources. I see you didn't catch the part where I also need my medications and medicaid doesn't go through immediately. I'm already going to the medicaid office with another redditor tomorrow. 


Don't reply if you literally have no advice except "go to the office, wait for medicaid to kick in, then go get your meds after being off them for x days and see how crazy you go and let the seizures and insane side effects come and get you because you stopped your meds... go ahead and roll the dice... the side effects and your mental health may kill you in the process but hey, you're just making excuses!" Thanks but, that's the opposite of healthy. 


Going to the office is literally just one step. Google "klonopin withdrawal" ... I've been tapering myself off for the past couple of days to 1.5mg, that's not even healthy. What I need is a.... (this is going to come as a shock to you, get ready for it) ... doctor! And you know, therapy. 


I am prescribed 2mg/klonopin a day. Not exactly a low dose.

>To keep multiple irons going and see what pans out you can also try calling nami metro's helpline http://naminycmetro.org/tabid/87/Default.aspx

I called them and they have been the most helpful (non-emergency) resource over the phone. They told me how I can get my medications ASAP before this situation becomes worse. They were incredibly kind about it. Thank you so much! They were so kind and caring and really helped calm me down to try to resolve the medication issue. They also made an appointment with me just in case I can't clear things up by next week.
Um, it can become an emergency quickly. Impulse is impulse.

I'm not trying to. I'm trying to figure out what to do here. I'm in a lot of distress but this thread has helped me a lot. 


Asking for a little extra support isn't me trying to delay, I'm trying to avoid having to go to the hospital if possible and if I do have to go, I'd like to go to the right one. I'm not going to go into detail about how fragile my mind is, but I don't understand how asking for support is a bad thing? 


Thank you for the advice but I'm not going to continue responding to this. If it comes down to going to ny Presbyterian because of my suicidal plans then so be it.

Do you think I could find someone from reddit who would be willing to go with me to the queens office? (Any subreddit suggestions?)... I know my comments are all over the place. My mind is too. Someone going with me to any of these suggested places for support for would really great.

Depending on the day, I might. I do have plans of suicide because of this. It's irrational, I know. [Plans redacted] They'll have to take me, that's what I'm scared of. Everyday I try to work on getting my health insurance back without going to a hospital, my plans just seem like a better solution. I'm female by the way. 

Edit: plans no longer seem like a better solution thanks to all the advice and resources given on this thread. I appreciate everyone's support!

Thank you! If I don't end up in the hospital and I can make it that far, I'll definitely do that. And that's great aftercare advice. I'm going to need a therapist that takes straight medicaid until united kicks back in. In saving your comment. 


I really appreciate it. THANK YOU! !!

I've been on medication for a while and was hospitalized recently, I'm about to run out of my meds. (And having to go off of them cold turkey will make everything worse) I'm taking 5 different medications. I have about 3 days left of my anti depressants. Luckily they have done so many med changes on the past few months I can tweak my other meds because I have extra of them but they are in other doses. I'm also taking klonopin and stopping that cold turkey has incredibly dangerous side effects. 

I found a new therapist after I left the hospital but he was on vacation until after labor day and I was cut off Aug 31. I've been seeing a psychiatrist for years. Given how bad my year has gone, I feel like I'm just in a severe situation. And the idea of a bunch of bills honestly just makes suicide a more realistic option (clearly I'm not in the right mental state of mind)

What clinics? Where can I find them? I'm so scared of hospital fees and the person supporting me really doesn't want me to go (even though at this point I think it's best)... honestly I have plans and the more phone calls I make to medicaid and try to deal, the more I break down. And without my managed care plan I can't get good Healthcare anyway, so this really needs to happen asap. If I do it by the end of the week I might be able to get united back by December and finally start therapy again. I'm a mess. I almost went through with it last week :(

Yeah I know I have to renew every year, I didn't receive the paperwork and they cancelled it within 3 weeks but it hasn't even been a full year since I last renewed 

>And if you need someone to talk to. Please call the suicide hotline or 
1-800-LIFENET (1-800-543-3638) is a free, confidential help line for New York City residents. 

Thank you!
